content.value: Before undergraduate study, I interned at Enginuitty Group Limited, a Trinidad and Tobago technology company helping public and private sector clients across the Caribbean with digital transformation.

, I supported branding, formatted documents for internal and client use, and designed social graphics. Through this process I learned how a consultancy uses design for consistency, clarity, and project communication.
